method: exercise_id of every JSON/JSONL file in a directory named set under phase1*/phase2* (_mock excluded; a file with > 1,000 ids is a corpus and skipped) is "used before" and skipped (preferred; relaxed per level only if < 25 remain). The 4,064 ids of each level are shuffled with one seed shared by the three wave-1 languages; de takes positions 0 mod 3, ua 1 mod 3, es 2 mod 3, so the three wave-1 sets are disjoint by construction.
